$comment: harness-result/1 — the shared evidence contract every worker writes to its task dir as result.json. Validated by `harness result validate` and by the worker Stop hook. Fields marked required must exist; enums are enforced.

fields.status: PASS = your role's checks succeeded with evidence. FAIL = a blocking problem exists. BLOCKED = you could not perform a required check (missing tool/context/authority). NOT_APPLICABLE = role does not apply; needs not_applicable_reason. NEEDS_REVIEW = a human decision is required.
fields.revision: output of `harness rev` after your last change (writers) or at review time (readers). The gate rejects stale evidence.
fields.files_changed: exact paths you modified. MUST be empty for read-only roles.
fields.evidence[]: {id, type, command?, cwd?, exit_code?, status?, summary, artifact?} — command evidence needs the exact command and exit code.
fields.findings[]: {id, severity, confidence, location, description, recommendation, blocking, status, requirement_or_rule?}
fields.tests: {executed[], passed[], failed[]} — names of test targets or commands actually run.
fields.claims[]: {statement, evidence_refs[]} — every material claim points at evidence ids.
fields.requirements_covered[]: requirement ids (e.g. PW.5.1, OWASP-A03) you verified.
fields.summary: free text, <= 400 chars, for the orchestrator
